verdict.rationale: Martin is built around natural-language operation. The docs show users telling it, by voice, SMS, WhatsApp, email or Slack, to manage calendar events, emails, Slack messages, reminders, to-dos and notes, with examples like "Text Jon my arrival time" and spoken note-taking requests. Community users corroborate this hands-on: it handled complicated requests correctly the first time, and one user relies on it for to-dos during daily coding. Missing for 10: systematic independent evidence of command reliability, beyond anecdotes and the vendor's own claim of a lower failure rate.
